query: Evidence that Direct Normal Irradiance will depart from its cutoff level during 2022-10-16

evidence.claim: Site-specific DNI peaks have been declining, and DNI on October 16 is forecast to remain below 60 W/m² even under clear skies.
evidence.exact_quote:
Longitudinal analysis of DNI values shows that peak solar intensity—recorded specifically during clear-sky intervals—has been diminishing consistently on a day-over-day basis. This steady decline in maximum achievable intensity suggests a persistent reduction in the terrestrial receipt of direct solar radiation within the Verdant Delta sector.

Specifically for the 16th, predictive modeling suggests a significantly constrained solar environment. Maximum radiation levels are forecasted to remain below a threshold of 60 Watts per square meter (W/m²). It is critical to note that this upper limit of 60 W/m² applies even under clear-sky conditions, reflecting the severity of the intensity degradation observed at this monitoring site.

impacts.rationale: The documented day-over-day decline in clear-sky DNI peaks contradicts a constant-level process, but no explicit fractional or absolute historical change is supplied.

The site-specific forecast covers the entire requested horizon and explicitly caps maximum DNI below 60 W/m², contradicting unqualified persistence of the last observed level. The threshold cannot be represented faithfully as a multiplicative or additive edit.
